title: Oxygen — molecular gas supplement and preserved table inventory, 2026-10-07
body:
# Oxygen — molecular gas supplement and preserved table inventory, 2026-10-07

Stage: IMPLEMENTED. Actual terminal evidence is in the [batch receipt](../../data/quality/thermal-oxygen-batch-2026-10-07.json); the wider scientific and image programme remains PARTIAL.

## Identity, primary source and applicability

The [unchanged master](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/data/structured/0008-Oxygen-O.yaml) owns MAT:0008:MOL:O2 at /ordinary_molecular_state. Its atomic identifier is a string at /oxygen_species/0, and the separate atomic ionisation entry is not a molecular thermal state. The [official NIST SI publisher table](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7782447&Units=SI&Mask=1&Type=JANAFG&Table=on) identifies O2 GAS, CAS 7782-44-7, with three fits over **100–700 K, 700–2000 K, 2000–6000 K**, on **mol O2** basis. Molecular functions cannot be converted into atomic functions by dividing by two.

New SRC-000516 links same_work_as SRC-000127 in the [canonical source registry](../../data/registries/sources.yaml). SRC-000133 remains separate cryogenic/fluid work. [Exact main-page bytes](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0008-2026-10-06.html.txt) and [publisher-table bytes](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0008-2026-10-06-table.html.txt) were actually retrieved on 6 October; the 7 October review does not change their retrieval dates. Chase 1998, March 1977 data review and January 2009 parameter fit remain distinct. Reserved rights are retained; no open redistribution licence is inferred.

## Calculations and evidence limits

The independent transcription/publisher review checked 62 rows, 186 Cp/S/H quantities and 62 additional Gibbs quantities. Shared Python/JavaScript arithmetic checked 303 samples/909 quantities and range/context refusal gates. The 700 K and 2000 K endpoints retain separate fit identities. In particular the printed 2000 K enthalpies 59.17/59.18 kJ/mol remain distinct. Reference residuals are preserved rather than set to zero. Applied pressure, coefficient uncertainty/covariance, isotope fractions and spin populations remain UNKNOWN or UNSPECIFIED. A separate entropy datum is not a coefficient uncertainty. These checks compare published functions and software calculations; they are not independent calorimetry or experimental replication.

## Preserved owners and outputs

The [table inventory](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/data/structured/0008-Oxygen-O-Table-Manifest.yaml) links ten unchanged authored tables with pending scientific-content review. Table 011 and graph 013 are new; the twelve original [graph reservations](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/data/structured/0008-Oxygen-O-Graph-Manifest.yaml) and original parent/manifest prefixes remain intact. The [reader supplement](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/0008-Oxygen-O-Thermochemistry.md), [structured evaluation](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/data/structured/0008-Oxygen-O-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml), [readable table](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/tables/0008-Oxygen-O-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.md), [CSV](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/tables/0008-Oxygen-O-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) and [heat-capacity SVG](../../records/0008-Oxygen-O/graphs/0008-Oxygen-O-GRAPH-013-Heat-Capacity.svg) use the same molecular owner, source, units, ranges and explicit unknowns. The existing curated adapter, extraction, sync, native plot and publication tools are reused; no production-code or schema change is needed.

Preservation checks cover 5,211 prior record files, 42 prior thermal owners/receipts, 71 gaps, 126 artifacts and 407 source nodes. The molecular master is unchanged. SRM126c owner/certificate/source/four artifacts/typed projection are preserved; only its global registry-input hash refreshes. Actual native image review passed. The early reviewer account limit is retained as an interruption and earned no acceptance credit.

Global coverage is 43 thermal owners/146 fits/14,746 rows/71 gaps/271 supplemental charts. All 119 canonical identities remain, including Foundation 0000 and Hydrogen 0001. All 143 master tasks,4,248 confirmed-domain reviews and 2,587 standalone confirmed-element panels remain pending. This chart earns zero A/B panel credit. The [existing selector](../../data/research/mat-update-review.json), [MAT TODO](../../data/quality/MAT-TODO.json), [resume](../../MAT-ADVANCED-RESUME.md) and [handoff](../../MAT_CODEX_CONTINUATION_HANDOFF.md) retain these boundaries. Final tests/build/browser/copy evidence is recorded only after actual completion in the receipt.

## Next executable requirement

Review Fluorine 0009 molecular F2 GAS from the private .mat-local/thermal-oxygen-2026-10-07/fluorine-next-preflight.json, its companion prose and exact 7 October NIST captures. Recheck master hash, current owners and physical/manifest collisions. Bind MAT:0009:MOL:F2 at /ordinary_molecular_state with mol F2 basis; /atomic_state lacks an explicit neutral charge and /fluoride is a separate ion. Independently review the single 298–6000 K column, all eight coefficients and 59 publisher rows before accession; retain the raw 298 K first row, 298.15 K reference and calculated residual without forcing zero. Do not copy Oxygen's three-fit or duplicate-endpoint assumptions. Preserve ten authored table IDs 001–010 through an additive inventory and twelve graph reservations 001–012; candidate table011/graph013 need fresh collision checks. Link a dated accepted WebBook retrieval to existing SRC-000160/SRC-F-004 using same_work_as; SRC-000159 is distinct atomic work. No next source ID is reserved; recompute canonical/alias/unresolved collisions only after source/software proof. Preserve UNKNOWN pressure/coefficient uncertainty/covariance and UNSPECIFIED isotope/spin scope. Reuse curated extraction/sync/plot, preservation, material guard, tests, publication, browser and final-copy gates. Continue 0010–0012 individually afterwards. Universal atomic-child projection, 71 bounded thermal gaps, all remaining domain reviews and standalone image panels remain pending; MAT stays PARTIAL.

sources.scope_note: Dated SI response for the existing Oxygen/O2 WebBook work SRC-000127. Preserve its original node and aliases. SRC-000133 is distinct cryogenic/fluid work; this retrieval is not independent evidence or a condensed-phase source.
sources.scope: The retained species is molecular O2, GAS, CAS 7782-44-7, InChI=1S/O2/c1-2. One mole of O2 molecules contains two moles of oxygen atoms; this is a species-count relation, not a thermodynamic molecular-to-atomic conversion. Bind MAT:0008:MOL:O2 at /ordinary_molecular_state with mol O2 basis. The master atomic ID is only a string at /oxygen_species/0; the separate ASD atomic entry is not a molecular thermal owner. No atomic O, O3, excited singlet O2, radical, oxide, peroxide or superoxide function follows. Isotopic composition and spin scope are UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-FIT; the authored triplet ground term does not resolve spin populations or isotope fractions over the fit domain. Three GAS columns cover 100–700 K, 700–2000 K and 2000–6000 K. Preserve each of the 62 publisher rows and both copies of the shared 700 K and 2000 K endpoints with their source columns. The rounded 2000 K enthalpy increments differ; do not average, impose continuity or infer a phase transition/physical uncertainty. Preserve the published enthalpy reference and calculated residual at 298.15 K. No extrapolation below 100 K or above 6000 K, liquid/solid oxygen, cryogenic fluid EOS, high-pressure magnetism/phase boundary, latent heat or equilibrium dissociation/ionisation mixture is inferred. Source aliases such as liquid oxygen and phase links do not change this GAS fit into a condensed function. Retain Chase 1998, the reported March 1977 data review, January 2009 new parameter fit, actual 2026-10-06 source retrieval, and 2026-10-07 private software review as distinct provenance. Shomate has no pressure variable: applied sample pressure is UNKNOWN; retain the reported standard-state context and separate one-bar entropy datum without arbitrary-pressure EOS. Coefficient uncertainty/covariance remain UNKNOWN. Separate CODATA entropy uncertainty, publisher output rounding and software residuals are not coefficient uncertainty. Independent parsing and Python/JavaScript arithmetic against the same publisher data do not establish independent measurements, calorimetry, experimental replication, uncertainty acceptance or complete Oxygen thermophysics. A dated WebBook snapshot should propose same_work_as SRC-000127/SRC-O-002; SRC-000133/SRC-O-THERMO-001 is distinct cryogenic/fluid work. Preserve all existing source supports and owners.
